outputs.explanation: Panel A contains bar graphs quantifying band intensities (Nuclear, Cytosolic, Mitochondrial fractions) shown as mean ± SD with error bars, but no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the N=4 replicates) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across purification methods; it contains no plot of averaged quantitative data.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay); it contains no plot of averaged quantitative data.
